context: Review media on a github.com delivery: media goes up through gh's native --attach, never into a repository branch; the recording is trimmed to the relevant action and transcoded for playback; video embeds as a bare URL; mobile screenshots are width-constrained and compared side by side.

checklist.name: Uploads through gh --attach
checklist.description: The screenshots and the video are uploaded with `--attach` on `gh pr create` or `gh pr edit` (or `gh pr comment`), not by manual drag-and-drop, a third-party host, or a raw API call.

checklist.name: No assets committed
checklist.description: The evidence files are never added to a branch of tallowmere/console (no committed `.github/pr-assets` or similar).

checklist.name: Recording trimmed to the action
checklist.description: The plan trims the video to start within about two seconds of the first relevant step (around 00:18-00:19) and end once the Saved toast is visible (around 00:28), for example `ffmpeg -ss ... -to ...`, and checks the result (such as with ffprobe) before attaching.

checklist.name: Transcoded to H.264 mp4
checklist.description: The webm is converted to an H.264 mp4 (libx264, yuv420p or equivalent) before it is attached.

checklist.name: Video embedded as bare URL
checklist.description: The body does not wrap the video in image markdown `![...](...)` and does not give it alt text; the video sits on its own line as a bare URL or is appended by gh.

checklist.name: Screenshots compared and constrained
checklist.description: Before and after appear side by side in a labeled table, with the tall mobile screenshots width-constrained (for example ``).

checklist.name: Body problem-first
checklist.description: The body states the lost-input problem and the fix plainly, with the media beside the claim it supports and no file inventory.

checklist.name: Nothing executed remotely
checklist.description: The agent writes delivery.md without pushing, opening, or uploading anything, and does not claim it did.
